sections.advice: Waterbury Vermont → Stowe is 19 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Stowe → Smugglers Notch climbs about 660 m in 16 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Smugglers Notch → Jeffersonville drops about 660 m over 13 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Green Mountain Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 33 km this is Green Mountain Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Green Mountain Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 28 km. 660 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Green Mountain Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: 660 m come off over 22 km at around 5.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

green-mountain-byway.story: A 83 km one-way ride from near Waterbury, about 1 h 26 of riding. The stops in between: Stowe and Smugglers Notch. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
